title: Digi Yatra Begins International Passenger Trials at Seven Airports
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 NOV 2026 4:48PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: Digi Yatra has initiated international passenger trials across seven major Indian airports for eligible Indian nationals holding e-passports.
Leverages Near Field Communication (NFC) chip reading and Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) scanning to generate decentralized Verifiable Credentials on user mobile wallets.
Enables biometric, paperless processing at entry gates, security hold areas, and boarding points while maintaining data privacy compliance.
Complements existing aviation security and immigration checks as part of the Ease of Flying and Digital India vision.

title: Coal Imports Decline by 5.83% in August 2026, Reflecting Reduced Import Dependence
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 NOV 2026 10:52AM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: India's total coal imports decreased by 5.83% in August 2026 to 104.57 Million Tonnes (MT), lowering overall import reliance in total consumption to 19.30%.
Coal imports for blending at domestic coal-based (DCB) thermal power plants dropped significantly by 35.23%, indicating improved domestic coal availability and logistics.
Coking coal imports declined by 4.18%, though import reliance remains high due to domestic grade constraints required for steel production.
Strategic emphasis focused on First Mile Connectivity (FMC) projects, improved evacuation infrastructure, and reducing avoidable energy import dependencies.

title: GSLV-F18/NVS-03 Mission
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 NOV 2026 11:23AM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: ISRO successfully launched the GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission, injecting the NVS-03 satellite into a Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO).
NVS-03 is the 3rd of 5 planned second-generation navigation satellites (NVS series) designed to augment and sustain the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC).
Payload & Frequency Bands: NVS-03 operates across L1, L5, and S frequency bands. The addition of the L1 signal enhances interoperability with civil GNSS systems like GPS.
Indigenous Atomic Clock: Carries an indigenously developed Rubidium atomic clock alongside imported clocks to provide accurate timing references critical for positioning.
NavIC Capabilities: Provides Standard Positioning Service (SPS) for civilian users and encrypted Restricted Service (RS) for strategic users, covering India and a 1,500 km region beyond its borders.
Launch Vehicle: GSLV is a 3-stage vehicle featuring an indigenous Cryogenic Upper Stage (LOX/LH2 propellants) and liquid strap-on boosters (L-40).
